primitives.name: Sitemap Graph Structure
primitives.verbatim_quote: # odds-api.io Category: **sportsbook** URLs discovered: **3,716** Sitemaps walked: 7 ## Sitemaps | Sitemap | Status
primitives.assumptions: All sitemaps are traversable; URL count is deterministic per sitemap.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When sitemap index returns 404, fallback to direct XML parsing.

layer2.mapping: Each sitemap entry corresponds to a node in a directed graph where edges represent hierarchical navigation paths.
layer2.telemetry: Number of valid sitemap entries vs. HTTP status codes.

primitives.name: Multilingual Path Taxonomy
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'L_{\\text{locale}}': 'dimensionless, language code identifier', 'N_{\\text{pages}}(L)': 'dimensionless, number of pages under locale L'}
primitives.assumptions: Each locale segment contains uniform content distribution across subpaths.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When N_{\text{pages}}(L) < 500, locale may be under-represented.

layer2.mapping: Locale-specific path counts form a kernel for probabilistic content sampling in GSI's belief engine.

primitives.name: Sportsbook Endpoint Catalogue
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'E_{\\text{endpoint}}': 'dimensionless, endpoint type identifier', 'N_{\\text{instances}}(E)': 'dimensionless, number of instances for endpoint E'}
primitives.assumptions: Endpoints are mutually exclusive categories with fixed instance counts.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If N_{\text{instances}}(E) = 0, endpoint is deprecated or misclassified.

layer2.mapping: Each endpoint maps to a distinct GSE state transition function for real-time odds fetching.
